parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State or imply the form $A/(x-2)+(Bx+C)/(2x^2+3)$. [B1] Guidance: if $1-A/(x-2)+(Bx+C)/(2x^2+3)$, or $A/(x-2)+C/(2x^2+3)$, award B0; M1 A1 for $A=3$ remains possible.
Use a correct method for finding a constant. [M1]
Obtain one of $A=3$, $B=-1$, $C=6$. [A1] Guidance: allow all A marks even if a different solution order would produce errors.
Obtain a second value. [A1]
Obtain the third value. [A1] Total: 5.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use correct method to find the first two terms of the expansion of $(x-2)^{-1}$, $(1-x/2)^{-1}$, $(2x^2+3)^{-1}$ or $(1+2x^2/3)^{-1}$. [M1] Guidance: symbolic binomial coefficients are not sufficient.
Obtain correct unsimplified expansions, through $x^2$, of each partial fraction. [A1 FT, A1 FT] Guidance: FT on $A,B,C$; printed forms include $-A/2[1-(-x/2)+((-1)(-2)/2)(-x/2)^2+\ldots]$ and $(Bx+C)/3[1-2x^2/3+\ldots]$.
Extract coefficient $1/3$ correctly from $(2x^2+3)^{-1}$, expand to $1\pm(2/3)x^2$, and multiply by $Bx+C$ through $x^2$, where $BC\ne0$. [M1] Guidance: allow a multiplication slip; allow miscopies in $B,C$ from 7(a).
Obtain $1/2-(13/12)x-(41/24)x^2$. [A1] Guidance: do not ISW. Total: 5.
